cues.text: You and Akihiko stand together outside Iwatodai Station.
Akihiko remembers something Yukari once said to him.
The men from the strip mall walk up with three more of their gang and spread out around you and Akihiko. Akihiko turns to face them, scowling.
Akihiko raises his fists, then glances at you. The two of you turn and run, and the gang gives chase.
